title: How many unit cubes make cubes of edge 2, 3 and 4?
description: Cubes of edge two, three and four are built layer by layer from unit cubes. Each layer is a square of cubes and the number of layers equals the edge. Keeko doubts the count for edge four, because the front face shows only sixteen cubes.
teaching_notes: One idea: a cube is a stack of square layers, so its count is the layer times the number of layers. Watch for students who count one face and forget the layers behind it.

source: How many unit cubes make cubes of edge 2, 3 and 4 units?
video_script.why: The child builds cubes of edge two, three and four from square layers and sees why the count is the edge multiplied by itself three times.
video_script.substitution: Count the unit cubes in one layer, then multiply by the number of layers, which is the edge.
video_script.anchor: a small cube of edge one unit, the unit cube
video_script.wrong_answer: a cube of edge four needs sixteen cubes
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko counts only the front face of the cube of edge four, four rows of four, and says sixteen cubes. That is one layer; there are four layers.
video_script.payoff_line: Eight, twenty seven and sixty four unit cubes make the cubes of edge two, three and four

final_answer.spoken: eight, twenty seven and sixty four unit cubes make the cubes of edge two, three and four

video_script.design: One idea: layers. Wrong idea: one face is the whole cube. The cubes are built on the stage layer by layer and the counts sit on the working board.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book.
<bookmark mark='unit'/>It starts with a small cube of edge one unit.
<bookmark mark='big'/>Bigger cubes have an edge of two units, three units and four units.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How many small cubes make each of these bigger cubes?

beats.on_screen: the outlines hold still and the words how many unit cubes? glow

marks.stop: the words how many unit cubes? glow in the accent colour

narration: <bookmark mark='stop'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: unit cubes laid in a flat square layer, then layers stacked up one on another into a cube

marks.layer: unit cubes fill a flat square layer
marks.stack: more layers stack on top of the first, one by one
marks.cube: the stack closes into a cube

narration: <bookmark mark='layer'/>We can build a cube from flat square layers of unit cubes.
<bookmark mark='stack'/>A layer holds as many cubes as its edge multiplied by itself.
<bookmark mark='cube'/>The number of layers is the same as the edge.

beats.on_screen: Given: cubes of edge 2, 3 and 4 units, built from unit cubes
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the edges are two units, three units and four units.

beats.on_screen: To find: the number of unit cubes in each

marks.find: the thing to find is written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the number of unit cubes in each of them.

marks.layer: one layer of 2 × 2 = 4 unit cubes is drawn

narration: <bookmark mark='layer'/>Step one, take the cube of edge two.
Each layer has two times two, which is four unit cubes.
<bookmark mark='layers'/>There are two layers, so two times four gives eight unit cubes.

marks.layer: one layer of 3 × 3 = 9 unit cubes is drawn

narration: <bookmark mark='layer'/>Step two, take the cube of edge three.
Each layer has three times three, which is nine unit cubes.
<bookmark mark='layers'/>There are three layers, so three times nine gives twenty seven unit cubes.

marks.layer: one layer of 4 × 4 = 16 unit cubes is drawn

narration: <bookmark mark='layer'/>Step three, take the cube of edge four.
Each layer has four times four, which is sixteen unit cubes.
<bookmark mark='layers'/>There are four layers, so four times sixteen gives sixty four unit cubes.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 8, 27 and 64 unit cubes, which are 2³, 3³ and 4³
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>Eight, twenty seven and sixty four unit cubes make the cubes of edge two, three and four.
These are two cubed, three cubed and four cubed.
<bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says 16 for edge 4; the front face of the cube of edge 4 glows, then the three layers behind it appear and the bubble is struck through

marks.doubt: Keeko's bubble appears and the front face of the cube of edge 4 glows
marks.behind: the three layers behind the front face appear one by one
marks.fix: the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks a cube of edge four needs sixteen cubes, because the front shows four rows of four.
<bookmark mark='behind'/>But the front face is only one layer. Behind it are three more layers.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Count every layer, not only the one we can see.
